BiblicalUsage: Tiras is the youngest son of Japheth named in the table of nations. Both Genesis and Chronicles list him last among Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal and Meshech, and that is all the record says of him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the silence is honest: a name can be kept for thousands of years on the strength of one line in a genealogy, and that is enough to matter.
